name: Plasma Etch Chamber
description: Reactive ion etching (RIE) chamber — chamber pressure, gas flow, RF power, plasma density, wafer temperature

operations.name: read_chamber_pressure
operations.desc: Read etch chamber pressure in mTorr (target: 50 mTorr for oxide etch)
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov al, 0x00
out 0x43, al
in al, 0x40
movzx eax, al
in al, 0x40
movzx ecx, al
shl ecx, 8
or eax, ecx
xor edx, edx
mov ecx, 3276
div ecx
add eax, 40
ret

operations.name: read_gas_flow_cf4
operations.desc: Read CF4 gas flow rate in sccm (target: 40 sccm)
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov al, 0x00
out 0x43, al
in al, 0x40
movzx eax, al
in al, 0x40
movzx ecx, al
shl ecx, 8
or eax, ecx
xor edx, edx
mov ecx, 6553
div ecx
add eax, 35
ret
operations.returns: Flow rate in sccm * 10 (e.g., 400 = 40.0 sccm, range 350-450)

operations.asm:
